question:
Select the correct word for the blanks in the given sentence.

I need a blue ________ for writing and my brother runs a ________ for dogs.
solution:
The correct answer is "**pen**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Pen" is the correct word to use for the first blank because it refers to a writing instrument.**
 
• Also, in the second blank the correct word to use is "pen."
 
• Here both the words are homonyms of each other i.e. a word that is spelt and pronounced like another word but that has a different meaning.
 
 
• The "pen" in blank 1 refers to an object that you use for writing in ink. (कलम)
 
• **The word "pen" in blank 2 will refer to a small piece of ground with a fence around it that is used for keeping animals in.**(बाडा)
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct sentence will be:
 
 
• I need a blue pen__ for writing and my brother runs a __pen__ for dogs.
 
 

​Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "Shelter" (Option 1) refers to a place where people or animals can take refuge or seek protection.(आश्रय)
 
• "Nib" (Option 2) refers to the pointed end of a pen that comes into contact with the writing surface.(नोक)
 
• "Herd" (Option 4) refers to a group of animals, typically cows or sheep, that are kept together.(झुंड)
